note: Accepted losses of CTIS -> ToSARIF -> FromSARIF for this example (docs/exporters.md, SARIF).

losses.reason: a converted document is a new document with its own idempotency key (a fresh UUIDv7)
FromSARIF numbers findings finding-N; finding ids are producer-local
SARIF has no asset; FromSARIF takes the asset from ConvertOptions
SARIF has no per-location commit; FromSARIF takes branch and commit from ConvertOptions (the exporter writes metadata.branch as run.versionControlProvenance)
only confidences 95, 85, 70 and 50 have a SARIF rule precision; others read back as ConvertOptions.DefaultConfidence
result.message carries the title; the scanner message has no second SARIF member
remediation.recommendation is written as rule.help, which FromSARIF does not read; steps, fix code and advisories have no SARIF member
secret details have no SARIF member (the masked snippet is kept in the region)
SARIF suppressions carry kind, status and justification only (the reason is written as justification when there is none)
threadFlowLocations carry location, function, message and role only
